beforeImage.name: Vantage Data Centers
beforeImage.description: Vantage Data Centers develops and operates wholesale and hyperscale data center campuses for large cloud and technology customers. It serves hyperscalers, cloud providers, internet companies, and large enterprises requiring large-scale data center capacity. The business is asset-heavy and contracted because it finances, develops, owns, manages, and operates large physical campuses under long-term customer commitments. This portfolio-company scorecard consolidates the North American Vantage exposure in the database: the DigitalBridge-led platform investment, the Vantage SDC stabilized North American asset portfolio, and the North American growth-platform exposure. Vantage SDC is not a separate operating company; it is a stabilized asset portfolio formed through a 2020 strategic partnership between Vantage Data Centers and a DigitalBridge-led investor group, with Vantage continuing to manage and operate those facilities as part of its broader footprint. Public materials identify Silver Lake as Vantage's launch sponsor and seller in the 2017 transaction, then as a lead investor alongside DigitalBridge in the 2024 equity round. CBRE Caledon invested in the 2020 stabilized portfolio, and GCM Grosvenor's Labor Impact Fund, L.P. committed equity capital to Vantage's North American growth platform.

afterImage.name: Vantage Data Centers
afterImage.description: Vantage Data Centers develops, owns, manages and operates hyperscale data-center campuses for cloud, AI, internet and large-enterprise customers. Founded in 2010 and headquartered in Denver, the global platform includes substantial United States and Canadian operations. This canonical record consolidates direct platform equity and manager-level North American co-investments while treating Vantage SDC as a stabilized 12-asset North American portfolio managed and operated by Vantage rather than as a separate company. DigitalBridge has held platform equity since the March 2017 acquisition and led the closed $9.2 billion 2024 recapitalization with Silver Lake. CBRE participated first in pre-SDC platform equity and then in the current Vantage SDC portfolio; DigitalBridge separately retains a 12.8% SDC interest. Pantheon Infrastructure plc has a current $34.7 million North American co-investment, GCM Grosvenor retains its disclosed growth-platform exposure, and PSP exited the North American and EMEA development platforms in 2024 while disclosing a residual Vantage interest. Exact post-2024 platform percentages, most vehicles, CBRE's SDC percentage, Pantheon's closing date and PSP's residual layer are not publicly disclosed. No signed Vantage sale or later ownership transfer was identified through August 23, 2026.
